## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run verify` pass locally
- [ ] Snapshot changes were read and confirmed correct, not regenerated blindly with `npm test -- -u`
- [ ] Country data changes cite an authoritative source (postal operator, government body, central bank, ITU/ISO) in the description below
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by a test
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in the README and the type definitions

Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/); the PR title is used as the squash commit subject.
